elements.definition: Code that is not directly related to the data science activity at hand, but provides useful scripting functions (e. g. importing or configuring libraries).
The process of loading a dataset of any type (e.g., .csv, .pkl) into a Jupyter notebook environment.
The process of preparing the dataset(s) for the subsequent analysis. It includes tasks such as cleaning, instance selection, normalisation, data transformation, and feature selection.

The process of inspecting the content and shape of a dataset to understand the nature and characteristics of the data. Note that it may involve the usage of visualisation techniques but differs in its purpose.
The process of applying statistical models and learning-based algorithms to learn from sample data.
The process of assessing a model using one/various evaluation metric(s) such as goodness of fit and accuracy.
The process of applying a model trained on a set of data to other or newly arriving pieces of data to forecast new values.
The process of obtaining a graphical representation (e.g., tables, plots, graphs) of a/several measurement(s)
The process of serialising and storing the data
Lines of comment including commented code.
